items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Micah Doodles. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Micah Doodles. About two months ago.

ctx.x: Micah Doodles. About two months ago.
For a funeral? Uh-huh. On a Saturday. I never saw them. I never saw a band with the Liberty either. Satchelor Liberty?
